request_json.title: KiteLoad current retry configuration
request_json.text: KiteLoad 5.2 current configuration capture dated 2028-05-21: automatic_retry=true; max_retries=2; retryable_condition=transport_timeout. max_retries excludes the initial attempt, so the current ceiling is three total attempts. HTTP 429 is not retryable under this configuration. This capture is not a historical configuration snapshot for any earlier run.
